name: Two Truths & a Lie
description: Two truths and a lie: spot your classmates' lies, then hear the story behind each truth.

instructions.message:
Welcome to Two Truths & a Lie!

You'll share two TRUE facts about yourself and one LIE.

Then everyone tries to spot each other's lies, 100 points every time you catch one. After each vote, the lie is revealed and the author gets the mic.

Make your lie believable!

collect.prompt: Two truths and one lie about yourself. Make the lie believable, it gets shuffled in with your truths.

processing.message:
Great submissions! Now let's see who can spot the lies...

Get ready to vote!

show-statements.message:
Next up: {{_current.playerName}}!

Three statements are landing on your screens, two true, one lie.

vote-lie.prompt: Two truths and a lie from {{_current.playerName}}, tap the LIE!

reveal-lie.message:
The lie was:

“{{_current.fields.lie}}”

{{_current.playerName}}, which truth surprises people most? Tell the story!

ai-analyze.instruction: These are 'Two Truths and a Lie' submissions. Each one has three parts separated by ' | ', the FIRST TWO parts are true, the LAST part is invented. Base your analysis ONLY on the true parts; never treat the last part of any submission as a fact. Identify interesting patterns among the truths: common themes (travel, pets, talents), the most surprising true facts, and shared experiences between students. Return a brief, engaging summary (3-4 sentences) highlighting the most interesting real discoveries about this group.

end.message: Thanks for playing Two Truths & a Lie! Now you know each other a little better!

recommendedFor: Classic icebreaker. Works well in advisory or the first week of class.
